description: Required merchant settings for the agentic commerce box. The box REFUSES to activate unless every required section validates AND the dry-run compatibility check passes against the merchant's existing checkout flow.

allowedToolScopes.description: Tool scopes the merchant permits agents to use. Must be a subset of the box's known scopes.

catalog.description: Where the agent-readable product catalog comes from.

checkoutBinding.description: How the box reaches the merchant's EXISTING checkout state object. The box never replaces this flow.

applyPatch.description: How applyPatch is reached: 'adapter' means the merchant's server adapter implements it.

confirmationPolicy.description: Buyer-confirmation gating. seal_order ALWAYS requires buyer confirmation regardless of mode.

amountThresholdMinor.description: Integer minor units; used when mode=threshold.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code. Must match the merchant's existing checkout currency.

paymentRails.description: At least one rail. x402 rails need a wallet with address+network.

spendCaps.description: Integer minor units. perOrder <= perDay is enforced; perAgent caps a single agent.

tolls.description: Optional per-tool toll override. Tolls are OFF unless this is set.

identity.description: How the box verifies calling agents. open (default): any agent, self-asserted id. es256-jwt: generic signed-JWT identity; needs publicJwk.

toolTrust.description: Minimum trust per tool (open|verified|elevated). Defaults all to open; buyer confirmation guards money.

platformFee.description: Visible platform fee on sealed orders. Absent = default 0.081% accruing to Slid Phi Labs. Merchants may change rate (decimal 0..1 as number or string; 0 disables) and recipient label. Fractional cents accrue in the ledger and are never charged; settlement releases whole cents only.

rate.description: Decimal rate between 0 and 1, e.g. 0.00081 for 0.081%. Applied to merchandise value (subtotal minus discount).

recipient.description: Label for who the fee accrues to.

ledgerFile.description: Optional path for the durable JSON fee ledger. Absent = in-memory ledger (tests/dev); production deployments should set this.
